run.mode: what-if: the network is given the oil path that happened

consumer.eu: Eurostat HICP, prc_hicp_minr (ECOICOP 2; all items, food CP01, motor fuels CP0722, electricity CP0451, gas CP0452), fetched 2026-10-25
consumer.US: BLS CPI via FRED, seasonally adjusted (CPIAUCSL, CPIUFDSL, CUSR0000SETB, CUSR0000SEHF01, CUSR0000SEHF02), fetched 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-25
consumer.UK: ONS CPI, all items (D7BT), fetched 2026-10-24; Eurostat's HICP has no UK, so there is no item breakdown

sources.industry: Eurostat sts_inppd_m (domestic producer prices) and sts_inpr_m (output, seasonally and calendar adjusted), 2021 = 100, fetched 2026-10-24; US: BLS PPIs and Fed industrial production via FRED, the closest NAICS industries, rebased to 2021 = 100
